faq.a: Tamim is associated with the Arabic form تَمِيم, whose core sense is tamim; complete, perfect.

faq.q: What is the origin of Tamim?
faq.a: Tamim is associated with Arabic. Tamim is Arabic تَمِيم (Tamīm), meaning 'complete, perfect'. It was borne by an Arab tribe and early Islamic figures.
Yes — the underlying form تَمِيم is Arabic.
Tamim can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
